subject: planner, statistics: fix the inconsistent est when table has no stats (#52427)
summary: Reviewed this commit diff vs parent for planner/statistics only. Changes make stats sync-load create an in-memory “fake” column histogram when a table/column has no analyzed stats but exists in metadata, avoiding falling back to coarser pseudoSelectivity and making IN() selectivity estimates consistent across stats-handle init paths; also skips plan-generated (negative ID) columns when collecting histogram-needed columns to avoid invalid load requests. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness/semantics/concurrency within the touched planner/statistics code.
